<<<<<<< HEAD # Skittermice
Tiny, flexible hunter-killer neogenetic lifeforms. They have the qualities of slugs, cats, and ferrets in equal measure.
## Diet
- Can eat raw meat. - Will get poisoned by Theobromine (Chocolate, Tea, Coffee) and Allicin (Onion, Garlic).
## Special
- Very small and light (half the size and a third the density of an average human). - Can be carried in bags as a Large item (2x8 squares). - Unable to sprint, but walk speed is increased. - Unarmed attack deals 4 Piercing and 1 Blunt damage.
## Benefits
- When grabbing a creature in Combat Mode, they latch onto the target, slowing them down and dealing 20% more melee damage. - Gain the ability to Skitter, which drops everything they're holding but increases their speed. - See in the dark.
## Drawbacks
- Take 15% more Physical (Blunt/Pierce/Slash) damage. - Their small hands are unable to use items that must be wielded in both hands, and some one-handed items must be wielded in both hands to be used. ======= # Skittermice
